2015 Nissan GT-R Black Edition in Super Silver with 21,000 (Chassis) miles for sale! This beast of GT-R is race-ready with a relatively fresh setup that was well spec'a, protessionally assembled and tuned. The heart of the build consists of an LMR Stage 3.5 billet 4.1L VR38 that's armed with a pair of Garrett 67mm turbochargers (ETS), power generated from this combination is transferred to the all-wheel-drive system through a Sauce Shop built transmission.

Fuel demands were met with the installation of an AMS brushless dual pump fuel system along with ID1300/ID1700 injectors (flex fuel). Following the built transmission, the drivetrain also features Driveshaft Shop rear axles, Linney transmission brace, Linney billet front differential, Linney billet bell housing, and more. The complete build list features numerous quality pieces, including an ETS Super Race intercooler, GotBoost piping kit, Linney 12 injector intake manifold, ETS 3.5" titanium intakes, MoTeC C1212 display, carbon ceramic brakes, Advan wheels wrapped in Mickey Thompsons, and tons more. Respected shops were involved with the build, including @cicioperformance, @atlsauceshop, and Ei Racing. A MoTeC M150 ECU maintains control of the setup, which was tuned by @taylor_leier with an output of 1640awhp/1205awtq on Cicio's dyno. The car hasn't been to the track since the new build was completed with the billet crank 4.1L, however the old setup went 8.3 @ 173mph in the 1/4-mile, the new setup should break into the 7's. The car also went from 60-130mph in 3.07-seconds with the previous tune, the new setup should run 2's. Only 1,800 miles on the new build!

description:
Theres something unmistakably cinematic about the 2016 MercedesBenz AMG GT S a coupe that doesnt just look fast, it acts fast. From the curb it strikes a pose: long hood, short deck, and a stance so planted it feels like the car is already midcorner. The bodywork reads like tension made visible, sculpted to catch light in sharp, athletic bands. Its not trying to blend in, its built to be the main character, the one your eyes keep returning to when the room quiets.

Walk closer and the design gets even more persuasive. The front end is all purpose, the vents and contours feel engineered for attitude, and the details have that confident AMG confidencebold but not careless. Its the kind of exterior that looks different as the sun shifts: shadow makes it menacing, highlights make it gleam like a performance trophy. Even standing still, the AMG GT S suggests momentum.

Inside, the experience turns from spectacle to focus. The cockpit is a drivers address, wrapped in leather and brushed touches that feel premium without becoming precious. Seats hold you in the right placessupportive where you need it, comfortable where you want itso you feel connected rather than merely seated. Controls are purposeful, the layout is intimate, and the overall mood is one of youre in charge, even when the road is doing most of the work. Its luxury with a pulse.

On the road, the GT S is all about response and drama. It doesnt wait to be told what to do, it interprets your intent instantly, translating your steering and throttle inputs into confident movement with a sense of authority. The chassis feels composed and eager, making cornering feel like a conversation rather than a negotiation. The car encourages a more spirited rhythmturn in, settle, accelerateand it rewards you with a sense of control thats thrillingly natural. And then theres the sound: a growl that rises with acceleration and deepens into something rich and theatrical when you push, a soundtrack that turns every drive into a scene.

Practicality isnt the point, but its not ignored either. Its made for the joy of being out thererunning errands with an afterglow, taking the long way home, arriving looking like you planned it. The 2016 AMG GT S is less commuter and more invitation: a bold, expressive grand performance coupe that makes the act of driving feel special, even when youre just leaving the driveway.

Unleash iconic American muscle with this 2025 Ford Mustang GT Fastback, a performance-driven sports car that delivers exhilarating power, precision handling, and unmistakable style. Built on decades of heritage and engineered for modern performance enthusiasts, the Mustang GT continues to set the standard for V8-powered excitement.
At its core is the legendary 5.0L Ti-VCT V8 engine, generating thrilling horsepower and torque for heart-pounding acceleration. Paired with a responsive 10-speed SelectShift® automatic transmission (or available 6-speed manual), this Mustang delivers lightning-fast shifts and optimal performance across every driving condition. The exterior design is bold and aggressive, featuring a low, wide stance, signature LED tri-bar lighting, sculpted body lines, and a distinctive front grille that commands attention. The Mustang GT features a customizable 12.4-inch digital instrument cluster and a large 13.2-inch center touchscreen powered by SYNC® 4, offering seamless integration with Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto™. Track Apps®, selectable drive modes, and performance data monitoring put real-time control at your fingertips.
Premium materials and thoughtful design provide comfort without sacrificing sportiness. Available features include leather-trimmed seating, heated and ventilated front seats, dual-zone climate control, and an available B&O® premium sound system by Bang & Olufsen for an immersive audio experience.
Advanced safety and driver-assist technologies are integrated through Ford Co-Pilot360™, offering features such as Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, Lane-Keeping System, Blind Spot Information System (BLIS®), Rear View Camera, and more—delivering confidence to match the performance.
Key highlights include:


5.0L Ti-VCT V8 engine


10-speed SelectShift® automatic transmission (or available manual)


Rear-wheel drive performance platform


12.4" digital cluster & 13.2" SYNC® 4 touchscreen


Apple CarPlay® & Android Auto™


Selectable drive modes & Track Apps®


Available B&O® premium audio system


Ford Co-Pilot360™ safety suite

If you’re searching for a high-performance sports car with legendary V8 power, advanced technology, and head-turning design, this Mustang GT is ready to deliver an unforgettable driving experience.
Feel the power. Hear the roar. Drive the legend.

Whether you’re commuting through Buffalo or taking a scenic drive through Central Minnesota, this Camaro offers a blend of performance and practicality that stands out in its class.

Turn heads and ignite your drive in this one-owner F8 Green 2023 Dodge Challenger SXT, a modern muscle car that perfectly blends iconic styling, advanced technology, and everyday comfort. With only 22,166 miles and remaining factory warranty coverage, this Challenger delivers peace of mind along with exhilarating performance. Under the hood, a proven 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine paired with a smooth-shifting 8-speed automatic transmission with AutoStick delivers strong, responsive power while maintaining impressive efficiency for a vehicle in its class.

The standout Blacktop Package transforms this Challenger into a bold, street-dominating presence. Featuring 20-inch Black Noise painted wheels, a gloss black grille, satin black Dodge tail lamp badge, black fuel-filler cap, Rhombi 2-piece wheel center caps, and exclusive Challenger Blacktop badging, every detail reinforces its aggressive, sporty attitude. The rear black spoiler adds an extra edge to its already commanding stance, making this coupe impossible to ignore wherever it goes.

Inside, the driver-focused cabin combines comfort and performance with Houndstooth cloth sport seats, a leather performance steering wheel, and a leather-wrapped shift knob. Dual-zone automatic climate control, a power driver seat, illuminated entry, and a premium layout ensure every drive feels refined and comfortable. The advanced Uconnect 4 system with a 7-inch display includes Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration, Bluetooth voice command, and a media hub with USB and AUX inputs keeping you seamlessly connected on the road.

For audio lovers, the 6-speaker Alpine premium sound system with a 276-watt amplifier delivers crisp, immersive sound that elevates every playlist. Whether cruising the highway or navigating city streets, this Challenger ensures your soundtrack matches the experience.

Safety is engineered throughout with a wide array of advanced features including Anti-Lock Brakes, Electronic Stability Control, Traction Control, Brake Assist, a ParkView rear back-up camera, multiple airbags (front, side-impact, and overhead), anti-whiplash front head restraints, and a low tire pressure warning system. These systems work together to provide confidence and control behind the wheel.

Additional highlights include remote keyless entry, speed control, heated power mirrors, fully automatic headlights, steering wheel-mounted controls, and a split-folding rear seat for added practicality. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering deliver a smooth yet responsive ride that stays true to the Challengers performance roots.

If you're searching for a low-mileage, one-owner muscle car with bold Blacktop styling, premium Alpine audio, advanced safety features, and modern connectivity, this 2023 Dodge Challenger SXT stands out as an exceptional value with unmistakable attitude.

If youre looking for something fun yet practical, it makes a strong case for itself. One of the biggest reasons to buy is its unmistakable iconic styling. The MINI design has remained true to its heritage, with a retro-inspired shape, contrasting roof options, and unique details like Union Jack LED taillights. It stands out in a sea of generic subcompacts, offering a level of individuality that few rivals can match. Behind the wheel, the MINI delivers a driving experience thats genuinely fun. Its compact size, wide stance, and responsive steering make it feel agile and engaging, especially in urban environments or twisty roads. The turbocharged 1.5L engine provides lively acceleration, while the chassis is tuned for sharp handling that gives the car a go-kart-like feel. The Signature trim adds meaningful upgrades that elevate comfort and convenience. You get features like a panoramic roof, heated front seats, keyless entry, LED lighting, and advanced safety tech such as forward emergency braking. These extras make the car feel far more upscale than its size suggests, bridging the gap between economy and luxury. Inside, the MINI Cooper Signature offers a premium, quirky interior. Circular design elements, customizable ambient lighting, and a central infotainment display give it a unique personality. Despite its small footprint, the cabin feels high-quality, with available tech like Apple CarPlay and smartphone integration enhancing everyday usability. Fuel efficiency is another plus, with the base model delivering solid MPG for daily commuting, while still maintaining a spirited character. Add in multiple body styles2-door, 4-door, or convertibleand the MINI becomes surprisingly versatile for different lifestyles. Of course, its not perfect. Rear seat space and cargo capacity are limited, and the ride can feel firm on rough roads. But if you prioritize style and driving enjoyment over maximum practicality, these trade-offs are easy to accept. Ultimately, the 2019 MINI Cooper Signature is ideal for buyers who want more than just transportation.
